key_insight: For WC–Co–Cr coatings, detonation spraying favors higher hardness, while HVOF provides a dense, uniform microstructure and low friction.
engineering_relevance: Matching powder morphology and spraying method to service demands can improve the wear resistance and durability of machine parts under high loads and intensive friction.
method: Compare detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examine powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an average microhardness of 1449 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and a friction coefficient of 0.143 for HVOF coatings.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify test conditions or statistical variability, limiting direct extrapolation to service performance.
paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
